source: wave 130 latency investigation 2026-10-19; operator chose option (a)
summary: In wave 130, cycle 1956 waited the full 15 min shipwindow.DefaultTTL after its audit passed (01:13:10 to 01:28:10, no child process, no CPU) and then shipped unleased: 'WARN ship-window lease not acquired (context deadline exceeded); proceeding unleased'. The lease is taken at audit PASS (cyclerun_record.go:26) and held across the whole ship phase, which runs the repo-contract scanner pack (about 10 min, ship-repocontract-scan.log about 500 KB). With 4 lanes, the audit-PASS-to-push window runs one lane at a time, and a waiter that times out gets the rebase anyway. Operator decision (a): run the slow ship checks (repo-contract pack, stage hygiene, commit prefix) before the lease, then hold the lease only for the rebase onto main, the composed-tree gate of the identity carry (ADR-0105) and the ff-push. The lease then guards seconds, not minutes, and DefaultTTL can shrink to match.
title: The ship-window lease holds only the final rebase and push, not the whole ship phase
